table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	ServiceResultDetail.ServiceResultCode,   
	ServiceResultDetail.ServiceRowID,   
	ServiceInvCode=
		(SELECT SH.ServiceInvCode FROM ServiceDetail SD, ServiceHeader SH
		WHERE SD.SrvRowID = ServiceResultDetail.ServiceRowID AND SD.ServiceInvCode=SH.ServiceInvCode),
	ServiceCode = (SELECT ServiceCode FROM ServiceDetail SD WHERE SD.SrvRowID = ServiceResultDetail.ServiceRowID),   
	ServiceResultDetail.RowID,   
	ServiceResultDetail.ServiceHead,
	ServiceResultDetail.ServiceComponentCode,   
	ServiceResultDetail.ServiceComponentUnitCode,   
	AskComments = (SELECT MAX(AskComments) FROM ServiceComponentType SCT
		WHERE SCT.ServiceComponentTypeCode IN 
			(SELECT S.ServiceComponentTypeCode 
			FROM ServiceComponent S 
			WHERE S.ServiceComponentCode = ServiceResultDetail.ServiceComponentCode)),
	ServiceComponentTypeCode = 
		(SELECT S.ServiceComponentTypeCode 
		FROM ServiceComponent S 
		WHERE S.ServiceComponentCode = ServiceResultDetail.ServiceComponentCode),
	ValueType = 
		(SELECT U.ValueType 
		FROM ServiceComponentUnit U 
		WHERE U.ServiceComponentUnitCode IN 
			(SELECT SC.ServiceComponentUnitCode 
			FROM ServiceComponent SC 
			WHERE SC.ServiceComponentCode = ServiceResultDetail.ServiceComponentCode)),
	ServiceResultDetail.CostPrice,   
	ServiceResultDetail.SalePrice,   
	ServiceResultDetail.TestMachineCode,
	ServiceResultDetail.ComponentValue,
	ServiceResultDetail.ComponentValue2,
	ServiceResultDetail.LowerReferenceValue, 
	ServiceResultDetail.UpperReferenceValue, 
	Priority = (SELECT SB.Priority FROM ServiceBreakUp SB WHERE SB.ServiceCode IN (SELECT ServiceCode FROM ServiceDetail SD WHERE SD.SrvRowID = ServiceResultDetail.ServiceRowID) AND SB.ServiceComponentCode = ServiceResultDetail.ServiceComponentCode),
	ServiceResultDetail.Remarks,
	ServiceResultDetail.Comments,
	ServiceResultDetail.DeliveryDate,
	ServiceResultDetail.PrintOnReport
FROM 
	ServiceResultDetail
WHERE 
	ServiceResultDetail.ServiceResultCode = :ai_code
table.sort: code A, servicecode A, priority A, servicehead A, rowid A
